feature: Invites — Add a friend's chooser, path 2, the invite QR and the count line
note:
Plan `2026-10-16-invites.md`, PR 4; grown per UI PR. PRECONDITION: the signed-in account has `SOCIAL_FRIENDS_ENABLED` and `SOCIAL_INVITES_ENABLED` on, and at least one invite left (so card 2 opens and the QR row can make a QR). With invites off the head draws no count line and every row here times out on its `wait`, which is the good failure: the cell is not counted as reached.

Each `wait` names something only the finished surface draws (`data-invite-count`, `data-invite-card`, the email field's label, `data-qr-ring`), never `h1`: `/friends` renders inside the shell's `LoadingScreen` first.

The QR row WRITES: Show an invite QR holds one of the account's invites for 15 minutes (or re-shows the live one, which holds nothing new). Run it on a probe account, never a reader's.

The chooser, path 2 and the QR screen share one modal, portalled into `<main>`, so every step reaches it through `onPage` like the page itself.

The /admin rows (PR 6a, Admin M1 to M3) need the signed-in account to be an admin. They write nothing: the account and group rows reach their page by pressing a row or a card's Edit and photograph the field at rest, so no Save or Top up is pressed. Each `wait` names what only the invite surfaces draw (`account-invited-by` from `md`, the phone's `data-invite-meta`, `account-invites`, `group-top-up`).

shares.note: The ONE count line. `/friends`' head draws it through FriendsView (it passes the line to `FriendsHead` as a prop), so that row's `view` is `friends-view.tsx`; card 2 draws it in `invite-sheet.tsx`, path 2 in `invite-new.tsx` and the QR screen in `invite-qr.tsx`.
